name: Interface changes update README
instruction: Changes that alter the documented external interface update README.md in the same change set.
relevant_when: Diff that changes externally visible setup, runtime, deployment, CLI, environment-variable, exposed-port, file-location, container-parameter, or user-facing interface behavior.
context: CONTRIBUTING.md says pull requests must update README.md with interface changes, including new environment variables, exposed ports, useful file locations, and container parameters.
scope_reason: The rule depends on whether an interface-affecting source change and README.md update are present in the same diff.

checklist.name: readme-updated-for-interface-change
checklist.rule: If the diff changes an externally documented interface, README.md is also changed to document the new or changed behavior; otherwise this check is not applicable.

checklist.name: documentation-covers-changed-surface
checklist.rule: When README.md is changed for an interface update, the documentation mentions the specific changed surface such as the environment variable, port, file path, command, container parameter, setup step, or user-visible behavior.
